# Renewal evidence is assembled all year or not at all

The renewal briefs that changed negotiated terms were built from ticket references
recorded at resolution time; the briefs assembled in the renewal week from memory
produced renewals as-is regardless of the year's actual performance. Write the
performance evidence onto tickets as they close — the response window met or missed,
the escalation outcome — and the renewal brief becomes a query instead of an
archaeology project.
